'''Xun Garret''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Overseer/Legends|overseer]] of [[Tyed Kant]]. Under his administration there was a planet-wide ban on energy weapons, made necessary by Tyed Kant's volatile atmosphere, and military assistance given to nearby [[Demophon]] during its evacuation due to an impending [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Overseer Garret tended to give Imperial contracts to companies run by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], snubbing [[Alien/Legends|alien]]-run companies, or even companies originally founded by Aliens.
